automation.name: ISD-9261 - Parent Workaround Demo
automation.description: Reproduces ISD-9261. A newVariable task sets job variable 'inventory' to an object containing a nested 'devices' array. The childJob task has loopType=parallel — this exposes the enable query toggle in Automation Studio. The user wants to click enable query on data_array and type '[devices]' to extract the nested array inline. Clicking enable query throws: TypeError: Cannot set properties of undefined (setting 'childJobLoopIndex'). WORKAROUND: data_array is pre-wired to $var.job.devices (a flat array passed as job input), bypassing the need for enable query.

nv01._comment: Sets job variable 'inventory' to an object with a nested devices array. This simulates data arriving from an upstream system. The user's goal: use enable query on the childJob data_array field with query '[devices]' to extract the nested array inline and loop over it. ISD-9261 prevents this — clicking enable query throws TypeError before the editor opens.
nv01.name: newVariable
nv01.summary: Set inventory = object with nested devices array
nv01.description: Creates the upstream data object. The childJob below should ideally loop over inventory.devices using enable query — but ISD-9261 prevents that.

cj01._comment: ISD-9261 REPRODUCTION POINT: loopType=parallel + data_array exposes the enable query toggle in Automation Studio. Open this task's details panel and click enable query on data_array. The intended query value is '[devices]' — to extract inventory.devices inline. Instead the UI throws: TypeError: Cannot set properties of undefined (setting 'childJobLoopIndex'). WORKAROUND: data_array is wired to $var.job.devices (flat array passed as job input) so the loop runs without needing enable query.
cj01.name: childJob
cj01.summary: Run Child Demo — parallel loop over devices
cj01.description: Loops over devices in parallel. To reproduce ISD-9261: double-click this task, then click enable query on the data_array field. Expected: query editor opens. Actual: TypeError in browser console.

devices.title: devices
devices.description: WORKAROUND INPUT: The flat devices array. Without ISD-9261, this variable would not be needed — the user would enable query on the childJob data_array field with query '[devices]' to extract inventory.devices inline. Because of the bug, this array must be passed separately so data_array can reference it directly as $var.job.devices.
